## Install

1. Download `TrackEdge-<version>.zip` below, unzip it, and move `TrackEdge.app` to Applications.
2. Open TrackEdge. macOS blocks the first launch because the app is not notarized yet.
   Go to System Settings > Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway.
3. When asked, give TrackEdge Accessibility access in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Accessibility.

After an update, macOS may ask for Accessibility access again.
If the edges stop responding, remove TrackEdge from the Accessibility list and add it back.

Requires macOS 13 or later. Runs natively on Apple silicon and Intel Macs.
Check the download with `shasum -a 256 -c TrackEdge-<version>.zip.sha256`.
